WITH store_sales_agg AS (
    SELECT ss_quantity, COUNT(*) as count_, AVG(ss_ext_tax) as avg_ext_tax, AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) as avg_net_paid_inc_tax 
    FROM store_sales 
    WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    GROUP BY ss_quantity 
), bucket_thresholds AS (
    SELECT 1071 as threshold_1, 39161 as threshold_2, 29434 as threshold_3, 6568 as avg_ext_tax_threshold_4, 21216 as avg_net_paid_inc_tax_threshold_5
)
SELECT 
    CASE WHEN bt.threshold_1 >= ss_agg.count_ THEN ss_agg.avg_ext_tax ELSE ss_agg.avg_net_paid_inc_tax END as bucket1,
    CASE WHEN bt.threshold_2 >= ss_agg.count_ THEN ss_agg.avg_ext_tax ELSE ss_agg.avg_net_paid_inc_tax END as bucket2,
    CASE WHEN bt.threshold_3 >= ss_agg.count_ THEN ss_agg.avg_ext_tax ELSE ss_agg.avg_net_paid_inc_tax END as bucket3,
    CASE WHEN bt.avg_ext_tax_threshold_4 * 6568 >= ss_agg.count_ THEN ss_agg.avg_ext_tax ELSE ss_agg.avg_net_paid_inc_tax END as bucket4,
    CASE WHEN bt.avg_net_paid_inc_tax_threshold_5 * 21216 >= ss_agg.count_ THEN ss_agg.avg_ext_tax ELSE ss_agg.avg_net_paid_inc_tax END as bucket5
FROM reason r JOIN store_sales_agg ss_agg ON (ss_agg.ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 100)
JOIN bucket_thresholds bt ON true
WHERE r.r_reason_sk = 1
